fixed.description: parameter_id -> value, set ONCE before sweeping (constant context)

axes.description: ordered OUTER->INNER; axes[0] is the slowest loop

detectors.description: gettable parameter ids recorded at every point

zigzag.description: serpentine order: reverse inner axes on every other pass

diagonal.description: where several axes change at once (a new row), send every setpoint first, then wait for all

mask.description: DEPRECATED (2026-10-07 form, XY only): still read, translated into `scout` on load; never written

oneOf.title: zip (several params in lockstep = one dimension)
fly (INNERMOST only: one continuous move per row, binned by the measured position)

speed.description: fly speed, in the position's unit per second

speed_param.description: the settable the speed is set on

readback.description: the streamed position to bin by (default: param)

move.description: the stage that flies the row when param is a coordinate measured by something else (camera.laser_x); the grid, placement and binning stay in param's coordinates

lag_correction.description: move each sample back by its channel's declared delay (default true)

timeout_s.description: longest one row may take (default 3x the expected time + 30 s)

oneOf.title: repeat (sets nothing: everything inside it is done num times; any depth, but not inside a fly axis)

mode.description: keep (default): a dimension 'repeat' with coordinate 0..num-1, every repeat in the file; average: the dimension is collapsed to <det> (mean, NaN ignored), <det>_std (sample std; of |z| for complex) and <det>_n (finite repeats). At most one average repeat per scan; not with a fly axis or the resonance window; numeric detectors only

interval_s.description: repeat k of a pass starts no earlier than t0 + k*interval_s (t0 = start of repeat 0)

name.description: dimension name (default 'repeat', or repeat_1, repeat_2, ... when there are several)

when.description: before_scan: after `fixed`, before the first point; after_scan: after the last point, also after an Abort (not after an error)

axis.description: each_sweep / before_axis / after_axis: a DIM name (a raster gives two)

edge.description: each_sweep: before the first point of each sweep (default), or after the last one (not the scan's last)

on_error.description: continue = log the failure and carry on (e.g. an autofocus that finds no peak); default stop

action.description: a name registered in scan_core/hooks.py: call, wait_ms, autofocus, settle_extra -- or one generic step on its own: wait_until, abort_if, skip_if, pause, comment, compute_set (args = that step's mapping)

call_args.title: a routine: blocking sets (in order), then one blocking action -- or an ordered list of steps

set.description: settable parameter_id -> value; params the scan already holds are restored afterwards (except at after_scan)

action.description: a registry action id, e.g. vna.take_reference

steps.description: the ordered form: each step sets parameters, runs an action, or is one of wait_until / abort_if / skip_if / pause / comment / compute_set, in the order written; the restore runs once, after the last step

window.title: RESONANCE WINDOW: sweep a slow array detector only around the predicted FMR line (optional; stepped scans only)

detector.description: a 1-D array detector (trace over frequency) whose describe declares `window`

field.description: parameter id whose value at the point is the field B (mT, T, G or Oe)

angle.description: in-plane field angle: a parameter id, or a fixed number in deg (default 0)

margin_MHz.description: half width of the window around the predicted resonance

dip.description: the line is a minimum (transmission dip) or a maximum

track.description: correct Meff from every clean measured line

full_every.description: a full-band sweep every N points (and always at the first); 0 = only the first

scout.title: SCOUT PASS: take a quick look first (one scalar detector at every k-th point of the scouted axes, or a file), then measure in detail only where something is happening (optional; stepped scans only)

axes.description: {axis name: coarse step} for every scouted axis; for a picture the first is X (columns), the second Y (rows)

detector.description: what the scout reads (ONE number per point)

keep.description: measure where the reading is above / below the threshold, or deviates from the median by more than k x noise (MAD x 1.4826)

margin.description: grow the mask by this many GRID POINTS (per axis with a mapping); auto = half the coarse step

per_outer.description: the unscouted axes outside the scouted ones: one scout at their first values (once), or a new scout at every step (each)

settings.description: {parameter: value} held during the scout only, put back for the real scan

oneOf.description: an image (.png .tif .bmp .jpg) or matrix (.csv .txt .dat .npy) -- exactly two scouted axes -- or an earlier .nc scan (with `detector`)
an earlier .nc scan and the variable to read from it

extent.description: where a picture lies: X of the first/last column, Y of the first/last row

mask.title: XY MASK (2026-10-07, deprecated -- see scout): a quick pass of one detector (or a file) first; the scan then visits only the points inside the mask (optional; stepped scans only)

detector.description: what pass 1 records (one number per point), or the variable read from a .nc in `from`

axes.description: [X, Y] axis names; default the raster's

step.description: pass 1 at every step-th point of the fine grid

keep.description: measure where the reading is above / below the threshold

margin.description: grow the mask by this much, in the axes' unit; auto = half the source pitch

from.description: a mask source file: .nc scan, image (.png .tif .bmp .jpg) or matrix (.csv .txt .dat .npy)

extent.description: where a picture lies: X of the first/last column, Y of the first/last row

call_step.title: one step of a routine: sets (in order) then an optional action, or one of the five generic steps

expression.description: restricted expression (scan_core/expr.py): numbers, 'text', True/False, parameter ids (dotted, read from the status cache -- never a new acquisition), + - * / ** unary -, < <= > >= == != (chained), and or not, ( ), abs min max round. Checked when the recipe is validated.

wait_until.title: wait until the condition has been true for hold_s without a break

timeout_s.description: required: a sensor that never gets there must not hold the scan forever

on_timeout.description: stop (default) = end this scan cleanly (data kept, reason in attr stopped_by); stop_all = end this scan AND the queue it runs in; continue = log and go on

condition_step.title: abort_if (stop the scan cleanly) / skip_if (store the current point as not measured)

scope.description: abort_if only: scan (default) = end this scan, a queue goes on; all = end the queue too

pause.title: wait for the operator: Continue / Abort scan / Abort all

headless.description: a run with no GUI: fail (default) or only log the message

comment.title: append a timestamped line to the file's comments attribute; {param.id} is filled with its value

compute_set.title: set parameters to the value of a formula (blocking set; out of limits = the step fails)
